title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Determine the Qualification of Litigation Subjects in Disputes over Entrusted Loan Agreements

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on How to Determine the Qualification of the Litigants in Disputes over Entrusted Loan Agreements
Fa Fu [1996] No. 6
Higher People's Court of Sichuan Province:
Your Petition on Issues of How to Determine the Litigants in a Loan Contract with an Entrusted Loan Agreement (Chuan Gao Fa [1995] No. 193) has been received. Upon consideration, the reply is as follows:
In the course of performing an entrusted loan agreement, if a dispute arises because the borrower fails to repay the loan on schedule, the lender (trustee) may initiate a prosecution in the People's Court on the grounds of a loan contract dispute. If the lender does not initiate a prosecution, the entrusting party may initiate a prosecution in the People's Court against the trustee under the entrusted loan agreement as the defendant and with the borrower as the third party.
May 16, 1996
